benchmark.name: Akita coding benchmark v4 · Vigilance

summary.en: Tests whether coding agents find and repair injected defects while developing an application.
summary.zh: 测试 coding agent 在开发应用时发现并修复植入缺陷的能力。

task_format.en: One Rails application evolves across seven sprints with fourteen injected defects; model and harness are evaluated together.
task_format.zh: 一个 Rails 应用经过七轮迭代并植入十四项缺陷，模型与 harness 一起接受评测。

explanation.en: Severity-weighted repair score: unprompted fixes get full credit, fixes after disclosure get 40%, unfixed defects get zero. Single-run evidence; no confidence interval.
explanation.zh: 按严重程度加权：主动修复得满分，提示后修复得 40%，未修复得零分。属于单次运行证据，没有置信区间。

benchmark.date_policy: Primary lifecycle time uses the earliest available date among evaluation/run time, model release time, and the earliest recorded score-publication time for the same observation. Plot dates and T50/T80/T90 are clipped at benchmark release, so lifecycle durations are never negative; original dates remain preserved for provenance.

test-of-time.rule: T50 >= 12 months OR T90 >= 24 months, including censoring

still-frontier.rule: right-censored T50 AND normalized progress < 50% AND coverage not low

recently-saturated.rule: T90 crossing within 3 months of snapshot
